title: Definition of the arccos
text: There is an angle $$0$$ $$\leq$$ $$\theta$$ $$\leq$$ pi such that $$\arccos(-\sqrt{3}/2)=\theta$$

title: Possible $$\theta$$
text: In the range $$0$$ $$\leq$$ $$\theta$$ $$\leq$$ pi, $$\cos(\theta)$$ >0 for $$\frac{\pi}{2}$$ $$\leq$$ $$\theta$$ < pi

title: SOHCAHTOA
text: $$\cos(\theta)$$ is the ratio of the adjacent side to the hypotenuse of a right triangle with angle $$\theta$$

title: Important right triangles
text: The right triangle with adjacent side length $$\frac{\sqrt{3}}{2}$$ and hypotenuse $$1$$ is the $$30-60-90$$ triangle where the angle $$\theta$$ $$=\frac{\pi}{6}$$\n##figure1.gif##

title: Convert to the correct angle
text: In order to have the negative value, we take $$\theta$$ $$=\pi-\frac{\pi}{6}=\frac{5\pi}{6}$$
